application: scripts/depthn_screen_amended_verdict.py applies this file (by sha256) to the run's official readout (by sha256) and its result files; the official readout itself is unchanged
computed_before: Only the screen latency rule (CONTINUE: 0 timeouts in the first 1,000 searched decisions) and fairness checkpoint 1 (50 pairs, no flag) had been computed, and both carry no outcomes. No paired, score or outcome statistic of this run had been computed. The run's dispatch never depended on this rule, so its conduct is unchanged.
decided_by: the lead (search, V2, CUDA), on the evidence of one UNKNOWN RAW cell and Codex's RAW base rate (18 of 470, 3.8%)
replaces: the declared breakage rule unknown_cells_max = 0 (any UNKNOWN cell is breakage)

rule.breakage: drop unknown_cells; add unknown_share when either arm's UNKNOWN cells exceed 5% of its declared cells (the screen's 500 or the bar's 2,000); every other breakage item stands
rule.classification: every UNKNOWN cell is classified by cause (round_cap, foulplay_challenge_timeout, foulplay_choice_timeout, other) and by arm, with the arm difference in UNKNOWN share
rule.harm: the screen's harm check (upper bound < 0) stays on the declared estimator
rule.lower_bound: the verdict's lower bound is conservative: every UNKNOWN or missing search cell counts as a loss (0) and every UNKNOWN or missing RAW cell as a win (1); seed clusters (the two seats of a seed) and the same seed-clustered t interval, two-sided 90%; the bar at 2,000 is met only when this lower bound is > 0 with no breakage. The known-pairs interval (the declared estimator) is reported beside it, descriptive
